(ta)༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dzam+bha la ljang gu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dzam+bha la ljang gu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī dzaṃ bha lā ya/ khru phyed gser gyi pad+ma nor gyi 'dab ldan dag la lte ba'i snying po'i dbus su rdo rje ste// lha dang gshin rje gnod sbyin dag tu dag pa'i in+d+ra nī la pad+ma rā ga chu shel lo// nub tu rin chen karke ta ste me dang lha min 'phrog byed du ni rnon po zangs dang dngul// rlung gi 'dab ma dag la gser dang gser gyi lhang tsher dag las skyes pa'i gdan ni lte ba la/ 213 /snying por de steng gser las byas pa'i dzaṃ bha la ni phyag gnyis ne'u le dang bcas mchog sbyin pa// 'dab ma rnams la gser las skyes pa'am dngul las skyes pa'i lha mo brgyad de chu skyes mchog sbyin phyag /cod pan sangs rgyas rin chen dbang po nor bu mchog sbyin phyag ste gnod sbyin mo rnams de bzhin nyid// ha sogs thung ngu ring po phyogs dang phyogs bral 'dab ma rnams la yi ge brgyad rnams rim pas so/ 214 /dri dang me tog rnams kyis nyin zhag so so'i dus su thun gsum zla ba'i snod du mchod byas nas// oṃ dzam̐ swā hā'i mthar ste dbus su bha la dang bcas dza len+d+rā ya zhes pa sngags 'di yis// rgyal po rab dga'i yid kyis gser 'gyur mkhan rnams dag gis srung ba'i don du chu ni rab sbyin bya// de ltar bsrung ba'i mthu yis 'byung po'i mgon dang klu yi mgon pos ro ni 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ 215 /zhes dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i le'u lnga pa ye shes le'u las byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum mo// ༈ /da ni ro srung ba'i don du dzam+bha la'i mchod pa gsungs pa/ khru phyed ces pa la sogs pa ste/ 'dir khru phyed ces pa mtho gang tsam gyi gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar snying po'i dbus su rdo rje dag pa'i gser gyis bcing bar bya'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la in+d+ra nī la dang*/

lho'i 'dab ma la pad+ma rā ga dang*/ nub kyi 'dab ma la rin chen karke ta ser po ste/ byang du rin chen zla ba chu shel lo// de bzhin du mer rnon po bcing bar bya ste/ bden bral du zangs dang*/ rlung du gser dang*/ dbang ldan du dngul dang*/ lte bar rdo rje'i steng du gser gyi lhang tsher gyi gdan bzhag par bya'o// gdan de'i steng du gser las byas pa'i dzaṃ bha la phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pa ne'u le dang g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa ste gtsug tor gyi tshad kyis sor bzhi pa'o// de bzhin du 'dab ma rnams la gser las skyes pa'am dngul las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin mo brgyad rnams te pad+ma dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag go /'dir gal te dzam+bha la dngul las skyes pa yin na de'i tshe gnod sbyin mo rnams gser las skyes pa'o// gang gi tshe dzam+bha la gser las skyes pa yin na de'i tshe gnod yin mo rnams dngul las skyes pa'o// de bzhin du gang gi tshe gser gyi pad+ma yin pa de'i tshe dngul gyi snod do// gang gi tshe snying por dngul gyi pad+ma yin pa de'i tshe chu sbyin pa'i slad du gser gyi snod du 'gyur ro// cod pan sangs rgyas rin chen dbang po nor bu mchog sbyin phyag ste/ gnod sbyin mo rnams de bzhin nyid do// de bzhin du shes rab dang bcas pa ste dzam+bha la dang nor rgyun ma dang bcas pa ha lā ha la lta bu'o/

gar gyi stabs sam rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du lha mo sgeg mo phyag g.yas pas yab la 'khyud pa'i nu ma la/ yab kyi phyag g.yon gyis 'dzin pa'o// lte ba la dzam+bha la dang nor rgyun ma dag gi sa bon ham̐ haḥ'o// de bzhin du shar gyi lha mo'i hiṃ dang*/ mer hrīḥdang*/ lhor hṛṃ dang*/ bden bral du hṝḥdang*/ byang du huṃ dang*/ dbang ldan du hūm̐ dang*/ nub tu hl̥ṃ dang*/ rlung du hl̥̄ḥ'o// sgrol ma dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ spyan ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma ste/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ni nor rgyun ma'o// rdzas kyi don du khams thams cad rin po che chen pos rgyas btab pa gtso bo dang bcas pa bya'o zhes pa ni nges pa'o// de nas dri dang*/ spos dang*/ me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis nyin zhag so sor thun mtshams gsum la dngul gyi snod du mchod par bya'o// de nas oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā zhes pa'i sngags 'dis chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin par bya'o// rab dga'i yid kyis gser 'gyur mkhan rnams dag gis ni ro bsrung ba'i don du chu sbyin par bya ste srung ba'i cho ga 'di yis 'byung po'i mgon po dang klu'i mgon po ste klu'i rgyal pos ro ni 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro// de bzhin du gang dag ro 'phrog par byed pa'i lha min gzhan rnams kyis kyang ro 'phrog par mi 'gyur te rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bkas dzam+bha la'i srung bas so// zhes dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen dri med 'od las byung ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ chu dbang snying rje chen po la// btud nas ngo mtshar sgrub thabs ni// nor sgrub bcud len srung sogs la// lhag par bsngags pa 'dir brjod bya// rgyud 'grel las ji skad bshad pa'i rten tshang ba'am min na'ang shing las byas pa'am/

ri mor bris pas kyang rung ste/ chu sbyin gyi chas dang*/ mchod gtor mdun du bsham/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dus 'khor gyi lugs bzhin nam/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlab kyang rung*/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā ba sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dhā ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi/ bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtse mor pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'dab ma rnams phyogs kyi mdog can/ lte bar haṃ las 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog ljang gu/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du hāḥlas lha mo nor rgyun ma sngon mo phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang lhan cig yab la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du hiṃ las zla shel ma/ mer hīḥlas rab bzang ma gnyis nag mo/ lho ru hriṃ las sbyin ma/ bden bral du hṝḥlas sbas ma gnyis dmar mo/ byang du huṃ las 'phags ma/ byang shar du hūm̐ las dbyangs can ma gnyis dkar mo/ nub tu hl̥ṃ las sbyin bzang mo// nub byang du hl̥̄ḥlas lha mo dpal gnyis ser mo/ de ltar gnod sbyin mo dgu char yang g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs shing*/ g.yon pas rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhiḥzhes bsre/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gtsug tor tu haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣa rnams kyis rgyas gdab/ lha dbang bskur ba ni mi mdzad/ gal te byed par spro na chu dbang bskur te/

rigs drug gis so sor rgyas gdab/ lag mthil du a i ri u l̥'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bsdus/ zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin spyi dang mthun par dbul/ gtor ma yang gsol bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ.ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ i daṃ bā liṃ gan+dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ dha dā ma te/ te dza ā gat+ya sa pa ri wā ra shrī gh+ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ khā dan+tu/ bi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trista/ sarba satwa nāṃ/ shīn+taṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣi a ba ra ṇa/ gu sti kurbanatu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra a dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug /sgrol ma reg bya rdo rje ma// gos dkar mo dang mā ma kī /gzugs ma spyan ma dri rdo rje// gnod sbyin mo dgu'i tshul bstan pa// rab bskor 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin ni// dpal ldan mi bskyod rdo rje ste// thabs mkhas tshul gyis longs spyod ster// de dag rnams la gus pas 'dud// ces sogs dang phyogs mthun gyi bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kāt+yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ su dat+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha dra yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ de byai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa s+t+yai swā hā/ zhes gnod sbyin mo dgu'i mtshan sngags kyang ci rigs par bzlas la/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa ār+ya dzam+bha la sid+dhim+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ma ma dha naṃ/ da da tu/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes las sgrub pa'i sngags kyang cung zad bzla'o// mthar dngos grub blang ba dang*/

slob ma'i don du gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas phyag btsal nas gral du 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes gnang zab mo zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi ye shes le'u las bstan cing*/ nor sgrub pa dang bcud len srung ba la lhag par bsngags pa mgon po dzam+bha la ljang gu'i rjes gnang sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams sngon du song nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa sogs sngon du 'gro dgos pas slob dpon 'phags pa dzam+bha lar gsal ba la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes bskul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa dag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi// khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ srid 'gro nyam ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni// shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod lam rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dag pa gsum gyis bdag gi dngos 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do// ces lan gsum/

de nas sdom pa gzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos gzung bar bgyi// rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod par bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa bskyang bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba skyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// de ltar rgyud dag cing sdom pa dang ldan par byas nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig mdun bskyed kyi rten la pam̐ las pad+ma'i sogs nas/ bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyang ham̐ las 'phags pa dzam+bha la/ sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi/ zhes ye shes pa bsre/ de nas slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ham̐ ljang gu/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ham̐ ljang gu gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i ham̐ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzad la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig oṃ dzam̐ bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bā su dha ri ṇ+ye swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kan+t+yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dat+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha dra yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+ta yai swā hā/ oṃ de byai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa s+t+yai swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum re bzlar gzhug de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pas slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/

bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi phul ba'i me tog de slob dpon gyis sngags kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te dbu gtsug tu bzhag pas brtan par byas pa'i mos mdzod/ slob mar 'bru 'thor bzhin/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// slob ma 'di'i rgyud la 'phags pa dzam+bha la ljang gu'i gsung gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig ces dang*/ de nas dngos grub kyi slad du chu sbyin dbul bar bya ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bsang sbyang gi sngags dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams 'phags pa dzam+bha lar gsal ba'i mdun du/ paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtse mor nas/ gsang ba rak+ṣa rnams kyis rgyas gdab ces par spyan drangs rgyas gdab bya/ khyed rang rnams kyi lag mthil du am̐ i ṛ u l̥'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bsdus nas mdun gyi dzam+bha la'i zhal du phul bar mos la sngags gsung bar zhu/ slob ma'i ched slob dpon gyis dbul la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ de ltar chu phul bas mnyes shing tshims nas bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam pa'i mthar/ mdun bskyed kyi lha khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes gnang grub pas de dag gi gnas skabs su zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la srung sdom tshul bzhin bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs/ rjes gnang zab mo gsan pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad phul te cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/

deng nas sogs/ de rnams kyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i le'u lnga pa ye shes kyi le'u las byung ba'i dzam+bha la ljang gu'i rjes gnang dam pa gong ma'i phyag len bzhin tshang la ma 'khrul bar phul grub pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi thams cad sogs kyis grol lo// rjes ni/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bzod gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ bsngo smon shis sogs byas la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// tshul 'di dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las byung ba sgrub thabs rin 'byung du bzhugs pa nyid rjes gnang gi yig cha 'jug bde ched bklags chog tu 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba ste/ 'dis kyang mtha' yas pa'i ma rgan nyams thag pa rnams mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod kyi dga' ston la longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
